A small internal library. Run the tests with:

    python -m pytest -q

Record every change under "Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md.
files.tests/test_cache.py:
from cache import LRUCache


def test_stores_and_reads():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    assert cache.get("a") == 1


def test_evicts_when_full():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.put("b", 2)
    cache.put("c", 3)
    assert len(cache) == 2
    assert "c" in cache


def test_get_marks_entry_recently_used():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.put("b", 2)
    cache.get("a")
    cache.put("c", 3)
    assert "a" in cache
    assert "b" not in cache


def test_put_existing_key_refreshes_it():
    cache = LRUCache(2)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.put("b", 2)
    cache.put("a", 10)
    cache.put("c", 3)
    assert "a" in cache
    assert "b" not in cache
